attchmntText: Rmc Switchgears Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for financials for the quarter and half year ended on 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: RMC Switchgears Limited published newspaper advertisements regarding its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Priti International Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the same period. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 14, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, Priti International Limited reported total income from operations of 354.30 lakhs and net profit after tax of 11.50 lakhs. Earnings per share were 0.10. Vijay Solvex Limited announced that its consolidated and standalone un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, were approved by the Board of Directors on November 14, 2026. Ambuja Cements Limited reported consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations was 71,724.07 lakhs. Consolidated net profit after tax was 7,784.79 lakhs. Earnings per share were 1.76. The company also disclosed a dividend of 1.50 rupees per share.

attchmntText: Rmc Switchgears Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: RMC Switchgears Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting held on November 14, 2026. The company reported a consolidated revenue from operations of Rs. 8,890.79 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and Rs. 12,604.70 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Profit after tax for the quarter was Rs. 831.74 lakhs, while the half year profit after tax stood at Rs. 1,039.97 lakhs. Earnings per share for the quarter was Rs. 7.87. The Limited Review Report was issued by M/s Rakesh Ashok & Co., Chartered Accountants. The company also allotted 5,020 equity shares under its Employee Stock Option Scheme, 2024, on May 8, 2026.
